cohort: The study enrolled preterm infants admitted to a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit, born between 23 and 32 weeks of gestational age and/or with a birth weight less than 1500 g.
finding: The EUGR group at birth showed lower levels of L-cystathionine, kynurenic acid, L-carnosine, N-acetylglutamine, xanthurenic acid, aspartylglucosamine, DL5-hydroxylysine-hydrocloride, homocitrulline, and L-aminoadipic acid, suggesting a lower anti-inflammatory and antioxidant status compared to the non-EUGR group.
followup_time: Up to 36 weeks of postmenstrual age or at discharge for EUGR assessment
cross-section timing: Within 48 hours of life for urinary sample collection
